title: TractionCurrentTimingModelV2
description: Reconciled timing model defining explicit absolute vs incremental timestamp semantics, invalidating flawed prior arithmetic, and establishing an unambiguous latency budget for electrical traction de-energization.

timestamp_semantic_reconciliation.trigger_datum: t0 = E_STOP_COMMAND (0.0 ms, falling edge of NC safety contact)
timestamp_semantic_reconciliation.semantic_audit_finding: The recorded values (t1 = 11.8-12.8 ms, t2 = 19.2-21.6 ms, t3 = 31.2-35.8 ms) are ABSOLUTE timestamps relative to t0. They are NOT incremental stage delays. Treating them as incremental delays caused erroneous summation in earlier drafts.

audit_flaws.description: Summing 13 ms (safety relay drop) and 21 ms (contactor open) double-counted the 13 ms relay drop time because contactor auxiliary contacts open at t = 21 ms absolute, which already includes the 13 ms relay drop (contactor mechanical transit is only 21 - 13 = 8 ms).
13 + 21 + 6 = 40 ms. 48.8 ms - 40 ms = 8.8 ms. The prior report claimed T_persist <= 12 ms, which is mathematically false under its own equation.

timing_stages.name: E_STOP_COMMAND
timing_stages.description: Physical opening of dual-channel NC E-Stop contact (voltage drops from 24V to 0V).

timing_stages.name: SAFETY_OUTPUT_DEENERGIZED
timing_stages.description: Safety relay internal logic de-energization; OSSD outputs drop.

timing_stages.name: INVERTER_STO_DEASSERTION
timing_stages.description: Inverter Safe Torque Off circuit gates off IGBTs (t_phys = t1 + delta_t_STO). Physical motor current collapse begins BEFORE contactor mechanically opens.

timing_stages.name: CONTACTOR_OPEN
timing_stages.description: Main traction contactor auxiliary microswitch opens (t2 = t1 + delta_t_contactor_mech). Serves as diagnostic precursor (limit <= 35.0 ms).

timing_stages.name: PHYSICAL_CURRENT_THRESHOLD_CROSSING
timing_stages.description: Instantaneous phase current envelope collapses below guarded threshold (0.410 A RMS) via freewheeling diode clamping.

timing_stages.name: RMS_WINDOW_FLUSH_AND_PERSISTENCE_START
timing_stages.description: First sliding RMS evaluation frame k where I_RMS[k] <= I_guarded. Persistence timer starts.

timing_stages.name: SAMPLED_PERSISTENCE_WINDOW
timing_stages.description: All 100 consecutive discrete sliding RMS evaluation frames must maintain I_RMS <= I_guarded.

upper_bound_budget_verification.mathematical_formula: T_persist <= (48.8 ms - max(t_persist_start)) = 48.8 ms - 25.8 ms = 23.0 ms
upper_bound_budget_verification.conclusion: The 10.0 ms candidate persistence window satisfies the upper bound constraint with an exact margin of 13.0 ms to the 48.8 ms guarded limit.
